commit.message:
thermal_probe: a root of its own to check the thermal service on the phone

Prints kern.redwood.thermal every ten seconds under load and the audio DSP's
services, with no iOS needed (XL_RAMDISK=.../thermal_probe). First run on the
POCO X5 Pro: all 27 TSENS sensors read 33..38 C, cores at 1.8/2.4/2.4 GHz,
pressure nominal.
